message.content:
This editorial illustration features a man with balding hair wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, positioned in front of a large vanity mirror. The mirror has a thick brown frame lined with 14 illuminated circular white light bulbs. The man, seen from a three-quarter back view on the left, holds a makeup brush in his right hand and applies product to the face of his own reflection. His left hand holds an open round compact. The reflection shows him with closed eyes and a slight smile. Below the mirror, a tabletop holds various makeup tools: a black bottle, an orange tube, multiple brushes, a rectangular palette with circular wells, and a dark mat. 

Large black text across the top reads "TEMPO" above "ENAK DIBACA." To the left, white text reads "OPERASI MEMOLES CITRA" above a paragraph of smaller text beginning with "Presiden Jokowi...". Top banners include "INVESTIGASI," "Bisnis Ikan Anak Trenggono dan Pratikno H.40," and "Calon Komisioner KPK Selera Istana H.68." Bottom-left corner text includes "14-20 OKTOBER 2024," "RP 50.000," and a barcode.
